markers: SELECT action_url, username_value, password_value FROM logins

facts.text: get_credit_cards queries credit_cards and invokes decrypt_password on card_number_encrypted; this is static capability, not an observed recovered card.
mainpass passes browser results to save_results and combines the output directory as Browser.zip.

send_email creates an SMTP connection, enables STARTTLS, logs in and calls sendmail. mainpass supplies the zip path to this function; MIME attachment code needs to be included when claiming the complete attachment flow.
facts.scope: SMTP sending capability with configured credentials; no outbound connection was performed in this project.
